rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 326 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (elections_public_opinion led 11-20, geopolitics led 11-21, so policy_regulation leads today, then elections_public_opinion, then geopolitics); within each group the list starts at offset 326 % group_size in pool order (policy 326 % 15 = 11: AI licensing first; elections 326 % 9 = 2: synthetic media election first; geopolitics 326 % 10 = 6: AI datacenter siting first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-21, so items published 11-21 (after the prior harvest) through 11-22 are in scope. Context: Sunday 11-22 in Korea / Saturday 11-21 in the US and EU at harvest time — a WEEKEND: expect very few agency releases; likely yield is Friday-late (11-20 evening US) Federal Register/court items not yet harvested, Saturday wire reporting of official actions, weekend Korean 정부 보도자료 for Monday embargo (dated 11-22/23 are fine only if already published), and Taiwan pre-election official actions (Taiwan local elections Saturday 11-28 — CEC, MJIB, MODA, NSB official counts/takedown orders on AI deepfakes are high-value and NOT duplicates of the 11-21 Threads card unless they restate it). Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: California AG subpoena of Nvidia (covered 11-21; only Nvidia's formal motion/compliance filing, another state AG or SEC action, a BIS/DOJ action, or a congressional subpoena is new — Huang's Dec 1 testimony is a future hook, skip previews); Bessent's claim of a Trump–Xi human-in-the-loop military AI agreement (covered 11-21 via CNBC interview; only a White House/MFA written text, fact sheet, or joint statement is new); ACUS RFC on generative AI in agency adjudication (covered 11-21; only a final ACUS recommendation is new); UK DfE/DHSC AI in social care guidance (covered 11-21); Taiwan flagged ~2,700 Threads accounts to Meta (covered 11-21; only a new official count, indictment, or a formal CEC/MODA order is new); CCW 7th Review Conference closed 11-20 (adopted final document / LAWS GGE mandate text still NEW if posted — high-priority check); SAFE AI Act (only formal introduction with a bill number is new); Meta AI-scraping terms took effect 11-20 (only a new jurisdiction's regulator/court order or Meta changing the terms is new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
